account: It is day 0, just after 09:00. I came from home to town hall and read the secretary's appointment book. Today's schedule is routine: morning correspondence, a 10:00 market walk in the plaza, lunch at home, afternoon accounts, tea at a dockside cottage, then office and home. I have not yet discovered anything clearly unusual. The secretary is beside me holding a writable book. I asked about correspondence and unusual news, but have heard no reply yet. The builder has just approached us carrying a lantern; I do not know why, and carrying a lantern in the morning alone does not establish anything suspicious. Several townsfolk have been passing near the hall. I have a pre-existing feeling that something is happening without my knowledge, but so far I have no evidence of a secret activity, who might be involved, or its purpose. I intend to keep my appointments and learn more through conversation and observation rather than assume a conspiracy.
